answer: Agents deposit bonded stake and evaluate an epoch polynomial. RLN nullifiers and Semaphore zero-knowledge membership proofs bind each message to one authorized identity without revealing it. Duplicate messaging produces two polynomial shares under the same identity context; Shamir reconstruction then reveals the private key and immediately slashes the agent’s collateral. Polynomial identity commitments make cheating detectable, while atlas, velvet, and walnut serve as domain-separated labels rather than additional identities.
